== dev/nfet_01v8.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix M
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem dev/nfet_01v8.sym"
  xfp 6e3134164cc88266

pin d inout 20 -30
pin g in -20 0
pin s inout 20 30
pin b inout 0 0
  inherit VSS

param W 1u
param L 0.15u
param nf 1

impl spice spice
  format spice "X{name} {d} {g} {s} {b} sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='({W})/1u' L='({L})/1u' nf={nf}"

line 20 -30 20 -15
  layer 4
line 20 15 20 30
  layer 4
line 4 -15 20 -15
  layer 4
line 4 15 20 15
  layer 4
line 4 -15 4 15
  layer 4
line 0 -10 0 10
  layer 4
line -20 0 0 0
  layer 4
line 4 0 20 0
  layer 4

poly 12 15 16 12 16 18
  layer 4
  closed true

stext 25 -30 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
stext 25 1 R0 W=
  size 0.18
  layer 3
stext 25 13 R0 L=
  size 0.18
  layer 3

== root/ota.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/ota.sym"
  xfp a9d232977b2f4d5c

pin inp in -60 -20
pin inn in -60 20
pin out out 60 0
pin vbias in 0 40
pin VDD inout 0 -40
pin VSS inout 20 40

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

line -60 -20 -40 -20
  layer 4
line -60 20 -40 20
  layer 4
line 40 0 60 0
  layer 4
line 0 -40 0 -20
  layer 4
line 0 20 0 40
  layer 4
line 20 10 20 40
  layer 4

poly -40 -40 40 0 -40 40
  layer 4
  closed true

stext -34 -27 R0 +
  size 0.2
  layer 3
stext -34 13 R0 -
  size 0.2
  layer 3
stext -40 -56 R0 {name}
  size 0.25
  layer 3

  inherit b VSS
  W 3.8813910462992726e-6
  L 0.5u

  L 1u
